errors.missingColumns: Could not detect category and amount columns in budget file.

errors.emptyWorkbook: No sheets with data found in workbook.

ui.appSubtitle: Parse card CSV/XLSX, auto-categorize, edit categories, import a budget, compare actuals to plan. Data persists in this browser and can be exported as JSON.
ui.dashboardHelp: The dashboard lists every category (including ones with no budget yet). Upload transactions to populate spend. Upload a budget spreadsheet or add lines on the Budget tab to set targets per category (totals are summed when multiple rows map to the same category).
ui.dashboardEmpty: No data yet. Import transactions (and optionally a budget).
ui.labelNoBudgetCategory: No budget line for this category
ui.transactionsImportHelp: Supports typical issuer exports (Chase, Amex-style columns). Amount sign is detected automatically; payment/credit rows are excluded from spend where possible.
ui.budgetImportHelp: Provide a CSV or Excel file with a category column and an amount column (headers like "Category" and "Monthly Budget" work). Each import loads rows from that file and replaces older spreadsheet imports; budget lines you add manually on the Budget tab are kept.
ui.budgetLinesIntro: Use the tabs below: planned amounts are real budget lines; the other tab lists categories that do not have a line yet (new categories show there until you add an amount). You can also use “Add budget line” above.
ui.budgetLinesEmpty: No budget lines yet. Import a budget file or use "Add budget line" above.
ui.budgetUnplannedTabEmpty: Every category already has a planned amount, or you have no categories yet.
ui.dataHelp: The app mirrors the future database shape in a single JSON document: categories, merchant rules, purchases (each with categoryId), and budget lines. By default it persists in this browser (localStorage). On supported browsers you can also link a local .json file on the Data tab so every change is written to disk. You can still download or upload the same JSON for backups.
ui.dataWorkspaceFileHelp: Chrome or Edge over HTTPS or localhost can save every change to a .json file you choose (mirrored to localStorage). The file link is remembered across restarts until you unlink.
ui.dataWorkspaceNotLinked: No linked file — data stays in this browser unless you download JSON below.
ui.msgLinkedWorkspaceExisting: Linked file and loaded state from disk.
ui.msgLinkedWorkspaceNew: Linked new file; changes will be saved there.
ui.msgUnlinkedWorkspace: File unlinked. Data remains in this browser.
ui.footerHosting: Open source layout for AWS static hosting (S3/CloudFront) or GitHub Pages.
ui.confirmClearPurchases: Remove all imported purchases from this browser?
ui.confirmReset: Reset app to defaults (clears local data)?
ui.msgImportedBudget: Loaded {count} budget lines from {file} (replaced prior spreadsheet import; manual lines kept).
ui.profileLocalOnly: Local profile — data stays in this browser.
ui.settingsDisplayNameHelp: Shown only in this menu. Nothing is sent to a server.
ui.settingsReducedMotionHelp: Respects reduced motion and tones down transitions.
ui.settingsLanguageHelp: Additional languages can ship when the app is localized.
ui.settingsNotificationsHelp: This offline build does not send push or email alerts.
ui.settingsPrivacyHelp: Exports are parsed in your browser. Nothing uploads unless you point the manifest at an external host.
ui.settingsSamplesHelp: Download the bundled test files to try imports without real statements.
ui.settingsMockDataHelp: Loads the same demo credit card CSV and monthly budget CSV as the download buttons above (parsed like a normal import). Transactions are appended. Budget lines from previous file imports are replaced; manual budget lines are kept.
ui.confirmLoadMockData: Load the demo credit card and budget CSVs? Transactions will be appended. Imported budget lines (not manual entries) will be replaced.
ui.msgLoadedMockData: Imported {purchases} demo transactions and {budgets} budget lines from the sample CSVs.
ui.errMockDataNoCategories: Add at least one category before loading mock data.
ui.categoriesSectionHelp: New categories appear on the dashboard and in transaction pickers. Existing rows are re-categorized from issuer category columns and merchant rules so names that match your exports can move out of Other automatically.
ui.msgAddedCategory: Added category "{name}" and refreshed rules on existing transactions.
ui.budgetAddLineHelp: Categories that already have any budget line (from an import or added here) are omitted from the list so you cannot add a duplicate. Importing a budget file replaces spreadsheet rows from earlier imports but keeps manual lines you added on this tab.
ui.errBudgetAmountInvalid: Enter a positive amount for the budget line.
ui.categoryQuickAddHelpTransaction: Creates the category, assigns it to this transaction, and re-runs auto rules on all rows.
ui.categoryQuickAddHelpBudget: Creates the category and selects it for the budget line form below.
ui.errBudgetLineExists: A budget line for "{name}" already exists.
ui.budgetAddAllCategoriesHaveLines: Every category already has a budget line. Clear the budget, import a different file, or add a new category to add more.
ui.budgetAddNoEligibleCategory: No categories left — add a category or clear budget lines
ui.errBudgetNoCategory: Pick a category for the budget line.
ui.deleteCategoryZeroSpendAria: Delete this category (no spending recorded in it)
ui.confirmDeleteCategory: Delete category "{name}"? Its budget lines and merchant rules targeting it will be removed. Purchases in this category move to Other.
ui.errCannotDeleteFallbackCategory: Cannot delete the default Other / fallback category.
ui.errCannotDeleteCategoryWithSpend: Cannot delete this category while spending is recorded ({amount}).
